links.status: Frozen definition; no study row exists at freeze.

question: On the same Kummer-tower refutation systems, does a radix-4 or radix-8 grading of the tower change F4's counted multiply-adds by a factor of 2 or more against the unit (radix-2) grading, and does that factor grow with N = m*t?

claims.text: The unit-graded instrument reproduces the committed R-t9-t10 rows exactly.
Every graded run decides every system as the unit run does; every planted row has planted_ok.
Per (m, t, control) the radix-2^k grading changes refutation multiply-adds by the reported ratio r_k(t).
The ratio grows, fades or holds with N over the ladder.
Any statement about N >= 24, cryptographic sizes or Pollard rho.

hypotheses.text: no_material_effect: 0.5 < r_k(t_max) < 2 for m in {2,3}, k in {2,3}, tower and null (author's prediction).
gain_growing or gain_constant for some (m, k) on the tower: falsifies H0.

primary.name: F_p multiply-adds in all eliminations
primary.definition: row field muladds of a completed refutation system

execution.backend_reason: No Iso Lab route from this session (no isolab MCP; AWS credentials rejected by STS 2026-11-04; isolab-experiment.yml takes ecbench specs only). Primary metric is counted and host-independent.

stopping_rules.rule: Run G0; stop if C1 fails. Then L2, L3, X2, A1 once each in that order. No reruns for outcome; censored rows stay censored.

invalidation_rules: Any graded row disagreeing with the unit row on inconsistent, or a planted row with planted_ok false: instrument_invalid.
A graded row without a non-unit weights field: that row invalid.
A1 not bit-identical to L2-t8-r4: instrument_invalid.

decision_rule.text: Per (m,k): gain_growing if r_k(t_max) <= 0.5 on every draw and r_k non-increasing over the last three completed t; gain_constant if <= 0.5 on every draw otherwise; loss if >= 2 on every draw; no_material_effect if strictly between on every draw; mixed if draws disagree. Null control verdict computed the same way for attribution. X2 at t=10 must agree in band with L2 or the verdict is not_replicated.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: ratio r_k at t_max and its trend over the last three t

inadmissible: calling a constant factor an exponent change

literature.claim: tower quotient = group algebra; square-free normal forms

amendments.text: Instrument build from a pruned module list (build_prune.diff, deletions only in src/lib.rs and src/cryptanalysis/mod.rs; every compiled module is committed source). opt-level 3 if it fits this host's memory, else opt-level 1; recorded in build.txt. Counted metrics are build-independent; G0 regression decides admissibility.
